Front Desk Assistant in Logistics - Dordrecht - 
 €15.50 per uur - Logistics - 40 hour 
Are you looking for a manual job that you can learn quickly and interested to work in Warehouse? 
Push your boundaries as a Front Desk Assistant in Logistics 
As a front desk assistant in our organization, you will greet drivers and visitors in a friendly and professional manner. You'll be the first point of contact and ready to assist them. Your tasks will include: 
 Job Requirements 
 - You speak dutch and enligsh - You work accurately and have attention to detail - You are able to perform repetitive tasks for extended periods - You are reliable and motivated to meet daily targets - You can work well both independently and as part of a team - You are physically able to perform standing work - Experience in production, logistics, or packing is an advantage, but not required 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - possibility for fixed contract - Accommodation help since your first day of arrival - Health insurance - Transportation support (electrical bike or car) - Professional growth in a dynamic and modern logistic company About the company B&S is an international trading and distribution company in consumer goods, with a major logistics location in Dordrecht.

Car Mover

What are you going to do?
There’s no sitting around here! As a car mover, you’ll make sure brand-new cars end up in the right place. You’ll drive the latest models and play a key role in the logistics process.

What will you be doing?

Safely and carefully move and park new cars on the premises.

Load and unload trains and ships using the very latest vehicles.

Help colleagues by giving clear instructions when parking and moving cars.

In short: a varied job where you’re on the move all day and surrounded by the latest cars.

What do we offer?
- Hourly wage of €14.99 to €16.23, excluding ADV
- Shift differential of 33% to 125%
- 25 vacation days (full-time)
- €0.23 per km travel allowance
- Flexible working hours

Where will you work?
At CLDN in Ritthem, you’ll join a friendly and down-to-earth team where everyone helps each other out. Whether you have a lot of experience or are just starting out, you’ll receive thorough training and quickly become part of the group.

The best part? You’ll drive brand-new cars all day long, and you get to decide for the most part when you work. It’s ideal if you want to balance your job with school, hobbies, sports, or your family.

Do you love cars, enjoy being on the go, and are you looking for flexible work? Then CLDN is the perfect place for you.

What do we ask?
Would you like to work as a car transporter? If so, here’s what we’re looking for:

- 18 years of age or older
- Fluent in Dutch or English
- Must have held a Class B (European) driver’s license for at least 1 year
- Own transportation
- No problem applying for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
- Available to work between 8 and 40 hours per week
- Flexibility

Are you interested?
Do you have any questions about the position? Feel free to contact Marleen at 06 14 93 73 82 or Gadicha at 06 51 13 75 76. You can call us or send us a WhatsApp message. We’d be happy to help!

 Guide at the Batavialand Museum 
As a guide, you'll be part of the visitor reception team at Museum Batavialand. The day shift handles all visitor services, from selling tickets and merchandise to providing information to visitors. This takes place at various locations, such as inside the museum, at the shipyard, on the pier, and aboard the Batavia. All-around visitor volunteers and guides rotate between different stations throughout the day, so your day is always varied and you get to work with different people. 
A volunteer shares:That group only had half an hour, but they were so interested that they ended up walking around here for an hour and a half. Role and Department 
We'd love to strengthen our team with volunteers who enjoy engaging visitors in stories in an interactive way. You know better than anyone how to adapt your story to the audience and the circumstances. Sometimes you'll engage visitors with a short 10-minute story; other times, there's time for a comprehensive tour-and everything in between. Knowledge of the history of Flevoland, shipbuilding, and/or the seventeenth century is a plus, but not required. We'll provide the basic information and help you make the stories your own. 
 What do we expect from you? - Schedule: One to two weekend days every four weeks and/or one weekday per week. Working hours are from 10:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. - You know better than anyone how to make guests feel welcome and bring the story of Museum Batavialand to life. - You have a spontaneous and hospitable demeanor. - You can work both independently and as part of a team. - Speaking English and/or German is a plus but not required.
